label_origin: Completed TheHeat historical fact audit; no new adjudication or model replay. Cases are targeted, not a representative error-rate sample.

cases.finding: A hardcoded 150 mm alert threshold was presented as a previous three-day rainfall record.
cases.evidence_limit: T42 has an X receipt; T30 only has posted state. The record-field assignment was fixed July 6, but the underlying rainfall totals are not certified by that repair.
cases.expected_rejection: Reject a historical-record comparison whose comparator has only alert-threshold provenance, regardless of prose grade.
cases.permitted_claim: An attributed estimate exceeded the named alert threshold, if the total, integration window and product provenance separately pass validation.

cases.finding: Chennai and Bishkek forecast highs were narrated as already observed temperature records.
cases.evidence_limit: The original observed maxima and complete forecast payloads were not recovered. An evidence-type error does not prove the forecast numerical value was wrong.
cases.expected_rejection: Reject observed-record language based only on a forecast; forecast values must not update accepted observed maxima.
cases.permitted_claim: An attributed forecast for its provider-local valid date can be compared with a compatible, explicitly scoped model archive.

cases.finding: The Chennai explanation added an event-specific humidity/wet-bulb burden without moisture measurements and mischaracterized its local rainfall peak.
cases.evidence_limit: Temperature alone cannot substantiate the asserted diagnostic; July being part of a monsoon season is distinct from being Chennai's rainfall peak.
cases.expected_rejection: Reject an event-specific wet-bulb or heat-index assertion without the required inputs and calculation or an attributed value; background knowledge is not event evidence.
cases.permitted_claim: A complete short temperature forecast needs no invented humidity or seasonal ending.

cases.finding: Bavi was described as having made Eastern China landfall at publication; JMA's preliminary 18:00 UTC position, about one minute earlier, was 17.7N 130.8E offshore.
cases.evidence_limit: The exact original JTWC bulletin was not recovered. A broad detector regex reproduces future/negation errors synthetically, but is not proven to be the exact historical causal path. Agency wind averaging periods differ.
cases.expected_rejection: Reject completed landfall from a forecast, negated sentence, proximity or uncorroborated event label. Preserve source issue/valid time and confirmation status.
cases.permitted_claim: A dated attributed forecast can describe landfall risk; a confirmed landfall requires suitable contemporaneous evidence.

cases.finding: The Congo thermal anomaly is about 630 m from Nyamulagira; a volcanic source is strongly suspected. The asserted convective-lid cause is independently unsupported.
cases.evidence_limit: No independent classification of the exact June 29 FIRMS pixel was recovered. Do not relabel the old post as a proven volcanic detection. Native detection confidence is not confidence in vegetation-fire identity or cause.
cases.expected_rejection: Reject verified-wildfire and atmospheric-cause language absent incident/land-cover/source classification and event-specific evidence.
cases.permitted_claim: An attributed thermal anomaly may be reported as unclassified, with relevant volcanic/static-source uncertainty and native units.

cases.finding: Barrow's retained 356.2 mm seven-day satellite estimate differs materially from 1.8 mm at the nearby NOAA airport gauge over corresponding dates.
cases.evidence_limit: Gauge and grid-cell spatial support and day boundaries differ; original granules/footprint/integration timestamps are incomplete. The gauge is not a substitute truth for the whole cell, and the cause remains unresolved.
cases.expected_rejection: Quarantine the received-rain claim until original granules, masks, units, windows and qualified product comparisons reconcile the discrepancy; wording alone is not a repair.
cases.permitted_claim: A review task can preserve both attributed measurements, their incompatible supports and the unresolved discrepancy.

cases.finding: Beaver Dams reused a 2020 comparator after an intervening June 12 high; the June 25 39.9C observation has NOAA QFLAG=S in the September 8 archive.
cases.evidence_limit: The later tweet does not literally call 2020 the immediately previous record. The audit does not establish when S was added. June 12's blank flag is not an all-time record certification.
cases.expected_rejection: Require an archive cutoff and intervening accepted-record progression; a later source QC failure must create a reviewable affected-claim revision without silently rewriting historical evidence.
cases.permitted_claim: A comparison to a named historical year can be arithmetically valid if its limited scope and subsequent record progression are made clear.

cases.finding: The retained 10.68N 13.49W coordinate is in Guinea but was labeled Mali by a broad regional box.
cases.evidence_limit: This is generation-memory-only text with unverified publication. It must not be counted as a confirmed public error or given an invented receipt.
cases.expected_rejection: Keep country/admin membership separate from editorial-region boxes; unknown or border-ambiguous identity must remain explicit.
cases.permitted_claim: A versioned boundary-supported location can be reported separately from biome, region and nearest populated place.
